metadata.id_convention: zh-kepan: each id token is <sibling_index>_<level> in decimal, tokens joined by '.', e.g. '2_1.1_2.3_3' = second top node -> its first child -> that child's third child; sibling order is the source's order.
metadata.format_note: Compiled by chinese_workflow.eval.gold.authored from a hand-authored outline text (metadata authored_file; format in pipeline/src/chinese_workflow/eval/gold/README.md). One line per node, two spaces per level, heading_src verbatim from the commentary as ingest.lines reads it (checked punctuation-insensitively within ±2 lines of the node's @src, @exp or @ann line, or equal to a cb:mulu label on the @exp line). commentary.explained = the line where the commentary takes the node up (its topic marker 此初 / 下明… / 第二… / …者, a 品's cb:mulu line); commentary.announced = the line where the parent's announcement lists it (null when none; equal to explained for a sub-item the commentary only lists). root_text: basis lemma = start and end fixed by matching the commentary's quoted lemma 經「A至B」 in the root text (A starts on start, B ends on end; end_basis next-node when the end is instead the line before the next division, chapter when it is the 品's last line, extent-formula when a stated stanza count fixes it, manual when the annotator set it, the reading in a note); manual = the annotator's cut words where the commentary quotes no lemma (notes give them); chapter = the root text's 品 cb:mulu line to the last line of the 品 div. end is inclusive and equals the line of the last non-punctuation character before the next located division. display_label is generated unless the text gives one (see display_label_rule). metadata.coverage_spans lists the subtrees this gold encodes and defines the scoring scope: node_id (null = the whole document) and heading_src of the subtree root, the commentary and root-text spans it covers (inclusive lineheads; the split spans of the eval manifest are end-exclusive, so their end is the line after commentary.end), and max_level, the absolute outline level down to which the subtree is complete (null = full depth: every division the commentary takes up in the span). A predicted node is in scope iff its start locator (commentary.explained; in sūtra-mode root-text scoring, root_text.start) lies inside an entry's span and its level is at most that entry's max_level (null = no limit). Scope alone decides: in-scope predictions that match no gold node are FP, including under a node flagged truncated; out-of-scope predictions are neither TP nor FP. An entry's root_text bounds the covered leaves, not every node's span: a covered node's own root span may run past it. Flag truncated: the gold does not encode all of this node's source children; its encoded descendants are scored normally and its unencoded source children are not FN. In this gold the flag is informational, since the scope already excludes what it marks. Tree edit distance: prune the out-of-scope predicted subtrees.

nodes.evidence: T34n1723_p0661c09: 至下釋。論說〈序品〉有七種成就，成就者
notes: Kuiji's division of the chapter text: 「論說〈序品〉有七種成就」 (c09), the 法華論's seven, each listed with the sūtra words where it starts (c11–c25; R03 F23). The span is the text it divides, from 如是我聞 (the lemma Kuiji quotes at p0651b01, before the gates) to the end of the 品; the 品's title line T09n0262_p0001c18 is outside it.

Not a level here: Kuiji groups the seven 「七中分二，初二通序，後五別序」 (c25–c26) and lists the 通序 as five items whose fifth, 五所被機, 「此入眾成」 (c26–c28). He takes the text up by the seven (「七成就中，自下第二眾成就也」 p0666a15–a16 … 「下第七文殊師利答成就」 p0688a21), so the seven are this node's children. The grouping is treated differently from 陀羅尼品's 「有五，合為三類」 (T34n1723_p0850b04), where the three classes are a level because Kuiji takes the text up by class (「下二天」 b08, 「此十神」 b14; 「此初聖」 b05 takes up the first class's first item): 通序 / 別序 occur only in the grouping statement at c26 and never as a take-up marker in the 序品 commentary.
